import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the dataset
data = """
brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a bar chart for price distribution by brand
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='brand', y='price_usd', data=df)
plt.title('Price Distribution by Brand')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()

# Create a scatter plot for price vs megapixels
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=df)
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_2.png')
plt.show()

# Create a histogram for model year distribution
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(df['model_year'], bins=30)
plt.title('Model Year Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Model Year')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_3.png')
plt.show()
